name: ApplianceReplacement

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.background: An appliance is old enough that replacement is likely in the future

scenario_template.topic: Discussing the condition of an aging appliance
scenario_template.note: They think ahead rather than waiting for a complete breakdown

scenario_template.topic: Realizing a replacement would be a significant one-time expense
scenario_template.note: They do not want the purchase to disrupt other goals

scenario_template.topic: Starting a dedicated replacement fund
scenario_template.note: They ask how to estimate a monthly contribution

scenario_template.topic: Planning for purchase, delivery, installation, and disposal costs
scenario_template.note: Assistant reminds them to account for costs beyond the sticker price

scenario_template.topic: Choosing between repairing the current appliance and saving for replacement
scenario_template.note: They compare short-term and future costs

scenario_template.topic: Adjusting savings if the appliance lasts longer
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them treat extra time as an opportunity to build the fund

scenario_template.topic: Setting a household replacement-fund contribution
scenario_template.note: They appreciate being prepared before the expense becomes urgent

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
